technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with early stochrsi recovery signal, but severe lack of price confirmation above key moving averages, negative momentum indicators, and weak volume support create high false-signal risk.

fundamental.summary: CDNS shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 48 days.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: low — small to medium amounts junior member
sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (26/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional activity is mixed and non-directional with no clear conviction signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (308.0) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational earnings, and earnings event in 48 days adds binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9 & 14) with StochRSI upside cross in fear-zone market creates contrarian bounce setup near support (165.94), typical mean-reversion entry point.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar), zero price confirmation above key moving averages, negative momentum across all indicators (MACD, AO, CMF, OBV), weak fundamentals, and earnings binary risk in 48 days make this a false-signal trap with unfavorable risk/reward.
